_meta.purpose: CL-PHYS-03 §4 evaluation-layer venue opening hours. The evaluation layer injects a REQUIRED `venue_hours_policy` gate for every opportunity_id present here: an hour bucket whose LOCAL start is outside [open, close) can never become a 推薦. The pinned canonical opportunity records under data/v2/opportunities/ are never edited for this.
policy: A venue absent from this table is UNKNOWN, never assumed open: the gate is simply not injected (abstain). Hours are never invented to make a gate fire.
Every entry must carry source_kind + source + retrieved_at so the table can be audited.

Hours are the venue's LOCAL civil clock; [open, close) is half-open and the judged instant is the hour bucket START. Overnight windows (close <= open) are treated as malformed and abstain (UNKNOWN), never guessed.
confirmed_by is the owner ticket that asserted the window; a table row without confirmed_by is not authoritative.
